label: Refurb Tower Server
summary: A used tower server from a local office cleanout. It is the first real step beyond the desk PC, but still feels like humble small-business gear.

label: Second Tower Server
summary: Another standalone tower server for the garage office. It adds breathing room for small business sites without skipping ahead to rack-scale infrastructure.

label: Backup NAS Box
summary: A modest network storage box for backups, snapshots, and safer support promises. It is practical garage-office equipment, not enterprise storage infrastructure.

label: Support Runbook Binder
summary: A binder full of backup checklists, escalation notes, and after-hours triage steps. It is low-tech, but it helps the tiny shop stay calmer when support calls come in.

label: Business Line Modem
summary: A better modem and line-conditioning kit from the local ISP. It is still garage-office gear, but it gives traffic-spike clients a steadier connection to lean on.
